title: デビュー戦の後に・次はデッカく！

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Ha. Haha. Hahaha! I did it… That wasn't so bad…

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: All right! That's my debut done! Pretty good, right, Trainer?!
choice_data_list: Yeah. I didn't see any problems.
Yeah. I didn't see any problems.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I know, right? Heh. There was nothin' to be afraid of in the first place.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I'm aimin' to be the coolest Umamusume around, after all! Mwahaha!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Despite being proud of her victory, her face looks strained. I guess she was pretty nervous.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: The problem is what happens from here on out. Sorry, but I'm in no mood to take my time rackin' up awards.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Big shots have their own way of doin' things! You know what race I'm shootin' for next, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her next race… If she's really ready to push for it, the next step would be graded races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Graded races go from G3 up to G1, and the opponents get stronger each rank. So if she's looking for a new goal after her debut…

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Are you making fun of me? An easy race like that is yawn city.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Not bad, but it's still not enough for me.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Bullseye! I'm gonna blow everyone away with my awesome speed at my first G1! Sounds perfect for me, don't you think?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna amaze the whole world! Hahaha!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: So, Trainer, what's the next junior G1 race?
choice_data_list: Either the Hanshin J.F. or the Asahi Hai F.S.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: These two major junior G1 races are held during the same week. I tell her that both are mile races and have the same conditions.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Hmph. So it's really just about which one I wanna do. J.F. or F.S.?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I've got a good feelin' about the J.F.! There's just somethin' cool about how it sounds!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I dunno what the initials stand for, but let's do it! Next target: the Hanshin J.F.!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: J.F. stands for "Juvenile Fillies," but I'll keep that to myself. I have a feeling she won't remember even if I tell her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And with that, we've decided her next goal: The Hanshin J.F.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Vodka! I heard you're going to run in the Hanshin Juvenile Fillies!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Yup. Got anythin' to say to the Umamusume tryin' for G1 in her junior year?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: You gotta have somethin', right? Like, "I figured you would," or, "That's amazing!" Go ahead, say it.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: …Pfft. Hehe. ♪

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Hey, c'mon! Don't just stand there snortin'! Don't get full of yourself just 'cause ya can say the race name right!
